note: Paddling outfitter on the Wisconsin River headwaters that also runs a campground: 27 RV sites in two loops, 15-amp sites sized for teardrops, and walk-in and tent sites. The full-hookup sites are also rented seasonally. Generators are not allowed anywhere on the property. Staff ask RVs to call on turning onto Razorback Rd so they can be guided to the site. ATVs and dirt bikes may ride the campground road to nearby trails. --Claude
